extDescription.message: Your little hamster assistant for tracking daily sign-ins in the browser.
extDescription.description: Extension description shown in the Chrome Web Store and on the extensions page.

scriptsTitle.description: Heading of the script list view.

newScript.description: Button that opens the editor for a new script.

emptyScripts.message: No scripts yet. Create one to get started.
emptyScripts.description: Placeholder shown when the script list is empty.

editBtn.description: Button that opens a script in the editor.

confirmDelete.description: Confirmation dialog when deleting a script.

namePlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the script name input in the editor.

untitled.description: Fallback script name when the name input is empty.

newTitle.description: Heading of the editor when creating a script.

editTitle.description: Heading of the editor when editing a script.

save.description: Button that validates and saves the script.

cancel.description: Button that leaves the editor without saving.

invalidJson.description: Prefix before the JSON parser error message.

stepError.description: Validation error located at a specific step; $STEP$ is the 1-based step number and $REASON$ the reason.

runTitle.description: Prefix of the run view heading, followed by the script name.

runningStatus.description: Status line while a script is running.

runSuccess.description: Final status when the script finished successfully.

runFailed.description: Final status when the script failed.

runAborted.description: Final status when the script was stopped by the user.

stopBtn.description: Button that aborts the current run.

backToList.description: Button that returns from the run view to the list.

statusPending.description: Badge for a step that has not run yet.

statusRunning.description: Badge for the step currently executing.

statusOk.description: Badge for a step that succeeded.

statusSkipped.description: Badge for an optional step that failed and was skipped.

statusFailed.description: Badge for a step that failed.

lastRunLabel.description: Prefix before the last run summary in the list.

neverRun.description: List meta for a script that has never been run.

stepsUnit.description: Unit after the step count, e.g. "5 steps".

alreadyRunning.description: Shown when trying to start a second run.

runFailedToStart.message: Could not start: the background is unavailable. Try reloading the extension.
runFailedToStart.description: Shown when the background service worker dropped the connection.

errNotArray.message: Script must be an array of steps
errNotArray.description: Validation error: the JSON root is not an array.

errEmpty.message: At least one step is required
errEmpty.description: Validation error: the step array is empty.

errTooMany.description: Validation error: the step array exceeds the limit.

errStepObject.description: Validation error: a step is not a plain object.

errStepName.message: name cannot be an empty string
errStepName.description: Validation error: step name is empty.

errUnknownAction.description: Validation error: the action name is not one of the built-ins; $ACTION$ is the given value.

errUrlRequired.message: url must be an http(s) link
errUrlRequired.description: Validation error: open step URL missing or wrong scheme.

errValueRequired.description: Validation error: a required string parameter is missing.

errMissing.description: Validation error: a required numeric parameter is absent; the field name is prepended in code.

errKeyRequired.description: Validation error: press step key missing.

errScrollSelector.message: selector is required when to is "selector"
errScrollSelector.description: Validation error: scroll to selector without selector.

errNotBoolean.description: Validation error: a boolean parameter has another type.

errNumRange.description: Validation error prefix for a numeric parameter out of range; the field name and allowed range are appended in code.

editorModeForm.description: Editor tab that opens the visual form builder.

editorModeCode.description: Editor tab that opens the raw JSON editor.

addStep.description: Button that appends a new step with the selected action.

formEmpty.message: No steps yet. Pick an action below and add it.
formEmpty.description: Placeholder shown when the script has no steps in form mode.

stepLabel.description: Tooltip of the step number badge in the form editor.

stepNamePlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the step name input.

optionalLabel.description: Checkbox that makes a step skippable when it fails.

moveUp.description: Button that moves a step one position up.

moveDown.description: Button that moves a step one position down.

noParamsHint.description: Shown for actions that take no parameters.

fieldUrl.description: Field label for the URL parameter.

fieldNewTab.description: Field label for the newTab flag.

fieldActive.description: Field label for the active flag.

fieldLoadTimeout.description: Field label for the page load timeout.

fieldSelector.description: Field label for the CSS selector.

fieldTextContains.description: Field label for the text match condition.

fieldTimeout.description: Field label for a timeout in milliseconds.

fieldInterval.description: Field label for the polling interval.

fieldIndex.description: Field label for the element index.

fieldValue.description: Field label for the text typed into an input.

fieldKey.description: Field label for the keyboard key.

fieldTo.description: Field label for the scroll target.

fieldY.description: Field label for the vertical scroll position.

fieldBehavior.description: Field label for the scroll behavior.

fieldMs.description: Field label for a fixed wait duration.

fieldAttr.description: Field label for the attribute name.

fieldLabel.description: Field label for the log label.

optTop.description: Scroll target option: top of the page.

optBottom.description: Scroll target option: bottom of the page.

optSelector.description: Scroll target option: a specific element.

optY.description: Scroll target option: an absolute Y position.

optAuto.description: Scroll behavior option: instant, browser default.

actionOpen.description: Action name shown in the form editor.

actionWaitForElement.description: Action name shown in the form editor.

actionWait.description: Action name shown in the form editor.

actionClick.description: Action name shown in the form editor.

actionInput.description: Action name shown in the form editor.

actionPress.description: Action name shown in the form editor.

actionScroll.description: Action name shown in the form editor.

actionAssert.description: Action name shown in the form editor.

actionExtract.description: Action name shown in the form editor.

actionClose.description: Action name shown in the form editor.

tmplOpen.description: Name of the first step in the new-script template.

tmplClose.description: Name of the last step in the new-script template.

insertStep.description: Tooltip of the + button between two steps; the action currently selected in the dropdown is appended after a dot.

insertStepEnd.description: Tooltip of the + button that appends a step at the end of the list.
